claims.text: Adding a suitable refractory metal can overcome performance limitations associated with stable intermetallic formation in the Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy alloy.
Ti or Zr is a suitable refractory-metal addition for this alloy.
The refractory-metal addition will form a stable solid solution or precipitate.
The stable solid solution or precipitate formed by the refractory metal will enhance alloy strength.
The stable solid solution or precipitate formed by the refractory metal will increase resistance to degradation.
Adding Ti or Zr will improve room-temperature compressive behavior relative to the as-processed baseline.
Adding Ti or Zr will improve corrosion resistance relative to the as-processed baseline.
Adding Ti or Zr will improve high-temperature oxidation resistance relative to the as-processed baseline.
The baseline material is an as-processed Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy alloy with a non-equilibrium, metastable solid-solution-plus-intermetallic state.
